description:
USGS-mapped earthquake faults near a US street address: every mapped fault section within 5 miles, nearest
        first (name, section, distance in miles and feet, direction, age of the most recent movement from 'historic'
        (< 150 years) to 'undifferentiated Quaternary' (< 1.6 million years), slip rate and sense, mapping scale, USGS
        report link), or the nearest mapped fault within 100 miles; plus the USGS 2014 seismic hazard map value (peak
        ground acceleration with a 2% chance of exceedance in 50 years, %g). Takes a few seconds. Returns the tool page
        URL. Mapped faults only: not a geotechnical or fault-rupture assessment.
name: fault_lines_near_address
